name: Icelandic Water Holdings ehf
note: Founded in April 2004; Jon Olafsson is a co-founder (company press releases, 2007-07-17 and 2023-09-05). After the September 2023 recapitalisation, a new investor group investing through Liechtenstein-based Iceland Star Property Ltd. became the incoming majority shareholder; the Icelandic founders and Blackrock-managed funds remained significant shareholders.
